(schema)  version=0
    markdown: "Coralogix log parsing rules. Parsing rules transform unstructured log data into structured fields at ingestion time. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/data-transformation/parsing/log-parsing-rules/."
active  BoolAttribute optional computed
    description: "Determines whether the rule-group will be active."
applications  SetAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    default: setdefault.staticValueDefault value defaults to []
    description: "Rules will execute on logs that match the following applications."

    description: "Rule-group creator."
description  StringAttribute optional computed
    description: "Rule-group description"
hidden  BoolAttribute optional computed
id  StringAttribute computed
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
name  StringAttribute required
    description: "Rule-group name"
order  Int64Attribute optional computed
    description: "Determines the index of the rule-group between the other rule-groups. By default, will be added last. (1 based indexing). The value must be unique across every rule-group in the account. Terraform cannot enforce that, because rule-groups are separate resources that are planned in isolation, so two rule-groups sharing an order are only rejected - if at all - by the API."
rule_subgroups  ListNestedAttribute optional
    description: "List of rule-subgroups. Every rule-subgroup is a list of rules linked with a logical 'OR' (||) operation."
